aboutGame.title: What is Dragon Shelter?
paragraphs: Dragon Shelter is a cozy fantasy farming and life-sim game from Wild Forest Studio, published by Curve Games. You restore a forgotten farm, befriend and raise magical dragons, grow crops, cook enchanted meals, craft useful items, and help a gloomy town come back to life.

Whether you are hatching your first dragon, perfecting a recipe for a picky villager, or exploring distant fantasy biomes, our wiki covers every system with detailed guides, data tables, and step-by-step walkthroughs.

items.question: What is Dragon Shelter?
items.answer: Dragon Shelter is a cozy fantasy farming and life-sim game for PC and Steam, developed by Wild Forest Studio and published by Curve Games. You restore a forgotten farm, raise magical dragon companions, grow crops, cook enchanted meals, craft items, explore fantasy biomes, and help a gloomy town thrive again.

items.question: Where can I play Dragon Shelter?
items.answer: Dragon Shelter is available on PC via Steam. Use the official Steam store link on this page to view the latest price and system requirements.

items.question: How many Steam achievements are there?
items.answer: Dragon Shelter currently has 23 Steam achievements to unlock as you farm, cook, craft, explore, and restore the town.

items.question: Which languages are supported?
items.answer: The game currently supports English, Simplified Chinese, German, Russian, and French.

items.question: How do I raise dragon companions?
items.answer: Feed, pet, and care for each dragon daily to raise its bond level. Higher bonds unlock magical farming perks such as faster crop growth, better soil, and automatic watering.
